name: Question 2
problem:
Solve the initial value problem

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}]x(t),\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}].
$$

*Hint: The matrix has the eigenvalue ${\lambda }_{1}=2+\text{i}$ with the corresponding eigenvector ${v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-2+\text{i} \\ 5\end{aligned}].$*
